# ai_dotfiles — onboarding

## 1. Goal

**What:** The single source of the owner's global AI-CLI setup on macOS: one rules file, per-CLI settings keys, shared MCP servers and 29 skills, applied to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi and Antigravity so every CLI behaves the same way in every project.

**How:** `config/ai-clis.json` says which CLIs are on and where each reads things. `ai-dotfiles install` runs four Python steps that link what is read-only (the rules file, every skill folder) and merge what a CLI writes back (settings keys; MCP servers through `<cli> mcp add`); every write is backed up, atomic and rolled back on failure. `ai-dotfiles check` compares the live state with the repo, CI runs the unittest suites and shellcheck on every push, and a weekly GitHub Action mirrors each CLI's docs and reports upstream skill changes in a PR.

## 2. System design

**Shape:** one monolith of scripts and config, with no frontend or API: a CLI (`ai-dotfiles`) plus two GitHub Actions workflows.

### Tech stack

| Layer | Technology | Version | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| Language | Python, standard library only | 3.11+; CI runs 3.12 | `scripts/install.sh:19`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:35` |
| Language | Bash | — | `scripts/*.sh`, `scripts/ai-dotfiles` |
| Config | JSON for the desired state, Markdown for rules and skills | — | `config/`, `skills/` |
| Tests | unittest | — | `scripts/tests/`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml:38` |
| Lint | shellcheck (warning level), pyright | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `pyrightconfig.json` |
| CI | GitHub Actions | — | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| Targets | Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, Antigravity | — | `config/ai-clis.json` |

### Folder structure

```text
ai_dotfiles/
├── AGENTS.md                 ★ maintainer rules and the verify commands
├── config/
│   ├── ai-clis.json          ★ which CLIs are on and where each reads things
│   ├── global-agents.md      the one global rule file, linked into every CLI
│   ├── cli-settings.json     per-CLI settings keys: enforce and default
│   └── mcp-servers.json      shared MCP servers
├── skills/                   29 skill folders, linked whole into every CLI
│   ├── which-skill/          ★ the router: which skill fits which situation
│   ├── onboard/              this report's skill; facts.py is its scanner
│   └── skills.lock           upstream pin and local edits per skill
├── scripts/
│   ├── ai-dotfiles           ★ the command: install, update, uninstall, check
│   ├── install.sh            the four steps in order; uninstall.sh reverses
│   ├── healthcheck.sh        the live-state check
│   ├── install/              one step per source; installer.py writes safely
│   ├── upstream/             the weekly docs mirror and its PR report
│   └── tests/                unittest suites, one per script
├── docs/
│   ├── how-it-works.md       ★ the mechanism and each CLI's paths
│   ├── onboarding.md         this report, written by /onboard
│   └── upstream/             machine-written docs mirror and skill catalogs
├── reference/                verbatim upstream copies kept for comparison
└── .github/workflows/        ci.yml (tests, shellcheck); sync-cli-docs.yml
```

### Layers

```text
┌─ GitHub ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│ config/     CLIs on, the rules file, settings keys, MCP servers          │
│ skills/     29 skill folders; skills.lock pins the adapted ones          │

┌─ home ────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│ ~/.claude ~/.codex ~/.agents ~/.pi ~/.gemini                             │
│             the rules file, skills/*, settings, MCP servers              │

└───────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
            │ read at start-up
┌─ CLIs ────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
```

### Workflows

#### install — `ai-dotfiles install`

```text
desired state ──▶ installer ──▶ global files
                      └──mcp add──▶ MCP registry
```

- desired state (repo): which CLIs are on and where each reads things; the rules file, the settings keys, the MCP servers and the skills — `config/ai-clis.json`, `scripts/install/installer.py:26`
- installer (repo): `ai-dotfiles install` runs `install.sh`, one step per source; `update` fast-forwards `main` first — `scripts/ai-dotfiles:32`, `:33`, `scripts/install.sh:92`
- global files (home): links to `global-agents.md` and each skill folder, the `cli-settings.json` keys merged into each settings file, the command linked into `~/.local/bin`; every write backed up, atomic, rolled back on failure — `scripts/install/instructions.py:130`, `scripts/install/skills.py:65`, `:57`, `scripts/install/settings.py:157`
- MCP registry (CLIs): `<cli> mcp add` for each missing server; Antigravity's `mcp_config.json` is merged instead — `scripts/install/mcp.py:99`, `:78`

#### check — `ai-dotfiles check`, or CI on every push

```text
push ──▶ CI job ──▶ unit tests, shellcheck
ai-dotfiles check ──▶ healthcheck ──▶ unit tests, shellcheck
                           ├──▶ dry-run install
                           └──▶ MCP registry
```

- push (GitHub): every branch, and pull requests to `main` — `.github/workflows/ci.yml:3`
- CI job (GitHub): checks out, runs shellcheck and the tests on Python 3.12 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml:23`, `:35`, `:38`
- healthcheck (repo): what `ai-dotfiles check` runs — `scripts/ai-dotfiles:35`
- unit tests, shellcheck (repo): the same suites locally, plus a scan for machine paths — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:80`, `:72`
- dry-run install (home): `install.sh --dry-run` must report zero pending changes — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:22`
- MCP registry (CLIs): `<cli> mcp list` must show every shared server — `scripts/healthcheck.sh:54`

#### weekly sync — Monday cron in `sync-cli-docs.yml`

```text
cron ──▶ sync job ──▶ docs mirror ──▶ mirror files ──▶ upstream report ──▶ PR
                      ▲ pages                          ▲ pinned files
                      docs sites                       GitHub API
```

- cron (GitHub): Monday 01:00 UTC, or on demand — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:6`
- sync job (GitHub): runs the mirror, the catalog update, then the report — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:42`, `:43`, `:55`
- docs mirror (repo): fetches every page each docs index lists; a source below its page floor keeps the previous copy — `scripts/upstream/sync-cli-docs.sh:134`, `:168`, `:107`
- docs sites (outside): the Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Antigravity documentation — `scripts/upstream/sync-cli-docs.sh:3`
- mirror files (repo): `docs/upstream/`, Markdown pages and skill catalogs, never edited by hand — `scripts/upstream/sync-cli-docs.sh:74`
- upstream report (repo): reads the mirror, `skills.lock` and `cli-settings.json`; fetches each pinned file at its commit and on the default branch; writes the PR body — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:169`, `:160`, `:139`
- GitHub API (outside): pinned files and each collection's tree — `scripts/upstream/report-upstream.py:139`, `:104`
- PR (GitHub): `upstream-sync` force-pushed, the PR opened or edited — `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml:63`, `:66`, `:68`

#### skill use — `/which-skill` or any skill, in a CLI session

```text
session ──▶ skill link ──▶ skill folder ──▶ the repo that is open
```

- session (CLIs): each CLI loads skills from its own folder — `docs/how-it-works.md:79`
- skill link (home): `~/.claude/skills/<name>`, `~/.agents/skills/<name>`, `~/.gemini/config/skills/<name>`, made by the installer — `scripts/install/skills.py:65`
- skill folder (repo): `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, where every link points; `onboard` also runs its scanner `facts.py` — `scripts/install/skills.py:54-55`, `skills/onboard/SKILL.md:23`
- the repo that is open (outside): what a skill writes there, e.g. `onboard` its report, `grill-with-docs` its glossary and ADRs — `skills/onboard/SKILL.md:55`

## 3. Conventions

- Files: Python modules and tests in snake_case, one `test_<script>.py` per script; shell scripts and config files in kebab-case; every skill is a folder with a `SKILL.md`.
- Code: direct imports, no injection; each step imports `installer.py` from its own folder; subprocesses run synchronously through `subprocess.run` (`scripts/install/mcp.py:99`).
- Errors: shell scripts run under `set -euo pipefail` (`scripts/install.sh:22`); Python steps raise `ValueError` naming the path and refuse to guess (`scripts/install/installer.py:109`, `:140`); writes are backed up, atomic, and rolled back on failure.
- Tests: load each script by path and run against a temporary `HOME`, never the real one (`scripts/tests/support.py:11-18`, `scripts/tests/test_entrypoints.py:25`).
- Git: PRs squash-merged onto `main` with conventional-commit titles (`feat(skills): …`, `refactor: …`, `docs: …`) ending in the PR number; `main` is the only long-lived branch, plus `upstream-sync`, force-pushed by the weekly job.

## 4. Common tasks

- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests`
- Lint: `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/upstream/*.sh scripts/ai-dotfiles`
- Preview an install: `bash scripts/install.sh --dry-run` (zero changes on a configured Mac)
- Check the live state: `bash scripts/healthcheck.sh`, or `ai-dotfiles check`
- Install, update, uninstall: `ai-dotfiles install`, `ai-dotfiles update`, `ai-dotfiles uninstall`

## 5. Where to look

| I want to… | Look at… |
|---|---|
| switch a CLI on or off, or change where it reads | `config/ai-clis.json` |
| change a global rule | `config/global-agents.md` |
| enforce or default a CLI setting | `config/cli-settings.json`, then `scripts/install/settings.py` |
| add an MCP server | `config/mcp-servers.json` |
| add or update a skill | `skills/<name>/`, `skills/skills.lock`, `skills/which-skill/SKILL.md` |
| change how a step writes files | `scripts/install/installer.py` |
| change the weekly docs mirror | `scripts/upstream/sync-cli-docs.sh`, `.github/workflows/sync-cli-docs.yml` |
| see why a check fails | `scripts/healthcheck.sh` |
